name: Bot companion
author: Apeiron Zetta
description: A companion that lives in the app and knows it. It remembers what you tell it, and, if you allow it on the Mods page, what's in your app: how many alters there are, journals and check-ins, tracking, chat, the bulletin board and the timeline. You shape its personality, idle talk and looks. It runs fully on your device, with no internet, and it is a script, not a real mind: it only knows what you give it.
